ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the outer part of the nucleus?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the center of the figure there is a relatively large blue structure, inside which there are dark strip-like markings resembling chromosomes and a deep purple nucleolus-like mass. The outer edge of this blue structure is surrounded by a distinct pink/magenta boundary, and outside it there is also a pink cell region. Then reason: the question asks “what is the external part of the cell nucleus.” The outermost boundary of the cell nucleus in the figure corresponds to the nuclear membrane/nuclear envelope in biological terminology, therefore the answer is nuclear envelope.
